title: The Governance of Nonprofits and Their Social Impact: Evidence from a Randomized Program in Healthcare in the Democratic Republic of Congo
eligible_reason: Single adoption date: all treated health centers start the PDSS governance treatment in 2017Q1 (tr = treat==1 & event_time>0; tr0..tr9 = treat x event_time dummies on a common calendar clock). One treated cohort vs randomized controls; not staggered. Main data are confidential and not shipped.
design_notes: Health-center x quarter panel 2016Q1-2019Q2 (event_time -4..9, 0 = 2017Q1). Table 4: areg log outcomes on tre04 tre59 (treat x periods 0-4 and 5-9) + time dummies, absorb(panelid), cluster-bootstrap SE. Table 5: dynamic treat x event_time indicators (omitted -1). Table 6: outside-group comparison with four post-by-group regressors and pair-by-time dummies. Randomized assignment.
